items.evidence: README's play command (work folder, --ticks 900 --seed 5 --settings) printed one JSON object with tick, screen, menu_index, volume, difficulty, texts, cursor, piece, stock, grid, slot, slots, clock, speed, coins, served, lost, queue, customers, arrivals, replaying, replay_ready, ledger (plus an extra 'focus'). From tick 1 on, screen is title; a 0:enter acts on the title. Note: with --ticks 0 / --at 0 every value is null and texts is [] (see defects).
--frame f_night.png --size 800x480 wrote a PNG; its header reads 800 x 480. Eight frames taken and opened.
Fresh place: texts [Night Market, Layout, Ledger, Settings, Quit], menu_index 0; up at 1 kept 0, five downs stopped at 3, up gave 2.

Settings: Volume: 5 / Difficulty: Normal at first; 6 rights stopped at 10, 11 lefts stopped at 0; difficulty left x2 stopped at Easy, right x3 stopped at Hard; texts 'Volume: N', 'Difficulty: Normal'; Escape -> title.
Set volume 7 and Hard in one run (place kB); a second run on kB started at volume 7, hard; a fresh place kFresh started at 5, normal.
0:enter on fresh place: screen layout, cursor (0,0), piece stove, slot 1, stock 3/4/2, grid [], texts Layout, Piece: Stove, Slot: 1, Stove: 3, Table: 4, Lamp: 2, plus Enter/Escape lines.
Per-tick run: down/left at (0,0) stayed; up x5 stopped at y 4 (up raises y); right x8 stopped at x 7; menu_index stayed 0 and screen stayed layout throughout.
next_piece: table, lamp, stove; prev_piece: lamp, table, stove; 'Piece:' text followed each step.
place stove at (6,3): stove stock 3->2; second place on same cell: no change; 3 stoves then 4th refused at (3,3); 4 tables then 5th refused; 2 lamps then 3rd refused; stock texts followed.
erase on lamp at (0,0): lamp stock 0->1, grid and 'Lamp: 1' text updated; erase again on the empty cell: nothing changed.
Escape -> title; Enter -> layout with the same 8-piece grid, cursor (0,0); a later run on kC showed the same grid at tick 1.

next_slot 1->2->3->1; save_slot put the grid in slot 1, grid unchanged; load_slot on empty slot 2 changed nothing; after erasing the lamp and saving to slot 2, load_slot on slot 1 restored the lamp (lamp stock 2->1).
Later run on kC: slots [G1, G2, []] as left; next_slot + load_slot gave grid G2 (no lamp), stock lamp 2.
Enter on empty grid: still layout, texts end with 'Needs a stove and a table' (gone after the next word). With stove+table: night, clock 0, speed slow, coins/served/lost 0, grid unchanged, '18:00'.

Run with fast@40, stop@50, slow@100, fast@121, stop@1000, slow@1100, fast@1300, slow@1500, fast@1650: 198 sampled states matched my own progress model (clock, speed, HH:MM and 'Speed:' text), e.g. clock 1 at tick 29, minute 2 at tick 44 (progress kept across the speed change), clock 3 held from tick 50 to 100 while screen stayed night. Slow night shows 23:59 at minute 359.
5 nights: arrivals start 5, gaps min 4 max 10, last < 360, identical in every sample of a night; seed 5 gives the same list in separate runs (and in replay), seeds 1,2,3,4,5,7,8,11 all differ.

Independent simulator of the brief's rules matched every sampled minute (customers id/state/x/y/wait, queue, lost) in 5 full nights incl. a 4-table grid; seed 5, one table: arrival at 33 turned away with 3 queued, lost 1 at once; queued customers have x,y null.
Stove (0,0) next to table (1,0): customer 1 cooking at minute 5, eating at 25. Stove (0,0), table (2,0): cooking at 5, still cooking at 34 (simulator: eating would be 35).
Seed 5, no lamp: customer 1 pays at 35, coins 8, served 1. Lamp at (1,1) next to table (1,0): night 72 coins / 6 served (12 each); kept night with lamp 36/3.

Hard, stove not next to table, seed 3: customer 1 cooking wait 29 at minute 34; at 35 gone, no coins, lost up, and customer 2 seated and cooking at the same minute (table and stove freed at once). Full Hard/Easy/Normal nights matched the simulator.
Seed 5, one table: at minute 35 customer 1 pays (coins 8) and customer 2 from the queue is already cooking at (1,0) in that same minute; simulator agrees on all sampled minutes.
At clock 360: summary, texts Night over, Coins: 24, Served: 3, Lost: 46, Enter: title matching state; 4 customers in the stall at 23:59 added nothing to lost; Enter -> title.
Seed 5, stove+table, Normal: slow night 24/3/46, fast night 24/3/46, run with several speed changes and stops 24/3/46.

Escape at clock 8: paused, texts Paused/Resume/Title, clock 8 held for 20 ticks; Escape and Resume each went back to night at the same clock; Title -> title, ledger unchanged; a later Replay still played the earlier kept night (seed-5 arrivals), not the given-up seed-11 one.
Fresh Ledger screen: 'No nights yet'. After nights: ledger state newest first and screen 'Coins 36, served 3, lost 47, Hard' etc.; shown again in a later run (seed 9) on the same place.
After 4 finished nights the ledger holds 3 (36/3/47 hard, 24/3/47 hard, 48/6/43 easy); the first (24/3/46 normal) is gone; a given-up night and two replays added nothing.
After the first night: title texts Layout, Replay, Ledger, Settings, Quit, replay_ready true; a later run on the same place showed the same at tick 1.

Later run, seed 9, difficulty easy, grid without the lamp: Replay gave night, replaying true, 'Replay' text, seed-5 arrivals; frame shows the kept grid with the lamp; summary 'Replay over', 36/3/47 as the kept night; ledger and kept night unchanged (second replay identical). The state's 'grid' key shows the layout grid, not the replayed one (see defects).
Erased the lamp, changed difficulty to easy, then (another run) placed a table, saved and loaded a slot: Replay still played the seed-5 arrivals and gave 36/3/47.
Two copies of one kept folder, seed 7, same script, 1500 ticks: outputs byte-identical; seed 8 from a third copy gave other arrivals (5,11,18,... vs 5,10,17,...).
Layout frame: 8x5 grid, red stove at (0,0), brown table at (1,0), small yellow lamp at (1,1), teal cursor outline at (3,2); panel shows Piece: Lamp, Slot: 2, stock 2/3/1 as the state says.

Night frame at minute 30: grid with pieces, one grey queued square at the left, green (eating) at (1,0), orange (cooking) at (2,0), white (seated) at (3,0), matching state; panel shows Coins, Served, Lost, 18:30, Speed: Fast.

Title frame shows its texts with the chosen 'Ledger' larger/bold; settings frame shows Volume/Difficulty/Back with focus outline on the chosen one; ledger frame shows 3 lines and marked Back; paused frame marks Title; summary frame shows Replay over/Coins/Served/Lost/Enter: title.

README gives keys/how to play, says everything kept is in the --settings folder, and its two commands (play ... --ticks 900 and the --frame variant) ran as written and gave the JSON and an 800x480 PNG.

defects: With --ticks 0 (or --at 0) the printed state has every value null and texts [] instead of the title screen's state.
During a replay the state's 'grid' key shows the current layout grid, not the grid the replayed night uses (the frame and the result use the right one).
Customer ids count turned-away arrivals, so ids of customers in the stall skip numbers (e.g. 1,2,3,4 then 6).
Enter on Volume/Difficulty in Settings also steps the value (the brief names only Left/Right); README admits it.
Menus and texts are drawn in a small panel at the top right on every screen rather than as a screen of their own; title not centred (cosmetic).
